findings.title: Israel kills two MSF staff in targeted strike on Gaza clinic
findings.location: Gaza Strip, MSF clinic; prior reporting placed the incident near Al-Shifa Hospital, Gaza City
findings.affected_population_system: Medical humanitarian personnel and facility protection. MSF says the clinic was visibly marked and its location known to the Israeli military; Al Jazeera reports Israel claimed the two deceased were Hamas fighters. Neither claim is independently established here. The deaths were already recorded and must not be counted again. Physical damage and service interruption remain unverified.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: MSF called it a ‘direct hit’, saying its logos were visible and Israel knew the location. Israel said the two were Hamas fighters.
findings.source_type: Established news outlet reporting attributed statements by affected humanitarian organization and Israel

bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted MSF clinic search, direct Al Jazeera article inspection, Roya News statement cross-check, compared against 26 authenticated ledger heartbeats.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Previously logged MSF staff identification and deaths at 16:44. Newly captured facility marking and prior location disclosure claim and conflicting Israeli claim regarding status of the deceased. Not a new casualty incident.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Roya reproduces MSF's attributed statement; original MSF statement and original Israeli statement not independently retrieved. Publication date is publisher-displayed November 28; precise timestamp and time zone unknown. New to reviewed ledger, not proven first published within window. No production comparison.

official_first_checks.result: Latest listed situation report dated November 26; inspected directly; previously covered.
